name: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hubei DOTI Micro Technology Co., Ltd., based in Dangyang, China, has, since its founding in 2009, dedicated itself to the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of sophisticated optoelectronic thin-film components within China. The company's main product lines include camera filters and optical communication components. These critical elements are widely utilized across various end-user sectors, such as consumer electronics, automotive imaging systems, security surveillance technology, optical signal transmission networks, and data centers.
